data.text:
FP-GEN exaBase canvas v0.1

Purpose: RFP upload → AI extraction → review/finalize → fee calculation → proposal export.

Required secrets
• OPENAI_API_KEY
• LITE_LLM_ADMIN_PASSWORD

Required variables
• APP_URL
• AUTH_URL
• DB_USER / DB_PASSWORD
• CONFIG_CRYPTO_KEY
• DEFAULT_CURRENCY
• DEFAULT_OVERHEAD_PCT

Default proposal sections
1 Cover Letter
2 Project Understanding
3 Methodology
4 Scope & Deliverables
5 Schedule
6 Team Structure
7 Financial Proposal
8 Relevant Experience
9 Assumptions & Exclusions

  overhead: "labor_subtotal * overhead_pct"

data.text:
Review model payload mirrors the VBA handoff:
metadata, sections, schedule, team, financial, experience.

MVP runtime note: use the single internal service "api" for parse, fee, and proposal generation. Legacy parser/fee/export nodes are retained as reference only.

Before deploy: replace the api node image with your custom container built from fpgen_mvp/Dockerfile.

Outputs are intended to match FP-GEN proposal structure:
Cover Letter, Understanding, Methodology, Scope, Schedule, Team, Financial, Experience.
RFP/project profile knowledge can store prior proposals, CVs, schedules, deliverables, fee rates, and relevant experience.
